verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 has a dedicated first-party webhooks docs page saying webhooks let users react to process events, sandbox lifecycle changes, and file modifications. That is a documented event-subscription mechanism covering several event categories. The pack gives only a one-line summary of that page, so delivery details are unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented registration/subscription API details, payload format and signature verification, delivery/retry guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
